items.quote: I've tried three other platforms. Vestora is the only one where I actually understand what's happening with my money.
The AI portfolio has returned 14% in eight months. I haven't touched it once — that's exactly what I wanted.
Starting with $500 felt embarrassing before. Vestora made it feel completely normal. Now I'm at $4,800.
The rebalancing alone has saved me hours every month. It just quietly does its job in the background.
I recommend Vestora to everyone who tells me investing feels too complicated. It genuinely isn't, here.
Clean, fast, and the fees are exactly what they say they are. No surprises after six months of use.

items.a: Create an account, complete a short risk assessment, and fund your wallet. You can start investing in under five minutes with as little as $500.
Yes. Cash balances are available immediately. Asset liquidations settle within 1–3 business days depending on the asset class.
Vestora supports equities (US and international), major cryptocurrencies, physical gold, and income-producing real estate. AI-managed portfolios spread across all four automatically.
A flat 0.25% annual management fee, charged monthly. No commissions, no spreads, no hidden charges. If your portfolio grows, we earn more — so our incentives are aligned.
Assets are held in segregated custody accounts, separate from Vestora's operating funds. Cash balances are held at FDIC-insured partner banks up to applicable limits.
